*F-ABA* (Asynchronous Byzantine agreement) is part of *Channels, Agreement, Ledgers* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Cohen, Forghani, Garay, Patel, and Zikas. [*Concurrent Asynchronous Byzantine Agreement in Expected-Constant Rounds, Revisited*](https://eprint.iacr.org/2023/1003). In 21st Theory of Cryptography Conference (TCC), Part IV, volume 14372 of LNCS, pages 422–451, 2023.
- Canetti and Rabin. [*Optimal asynchronous byzantine agreement*](http://people.csail.mit.edu/canetti/materials/cr93.ps). In 25th ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC), pages 42–51, 1993.
